doc.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Naming her brothers and sisters
summary: She lists the siblings from Nellie and Evelyn to Shirley the baby, and says her mother kept incest in the family history before them.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you tell us the names of all your siblings, maybe starting with the oldest?

Yes. The eldest is named Nellie. She's named for my grandmother Nellie Wooldridge. And then came Evelyn, who's named for my mother. And then came Alex, Alexander, named for my father. He's the oldest boy. And then came Robert Ruland Wooldridge, the one who became the judge. And after Bob was Melvin who was a brilliant man, too, and Juanita, Kenneth, Betty Jean. Bill, William, was born, I think, after Betty. He died before I was born. And then Anna Marie and David and Shirley.

Shirley is the baby. There was no incest practiced in our house. Mama talked about incest and our grandfather went to jail for abusing his stepdaughters and she never let us forget it and it was a blessing because nobody -- we didn't go through that.
